info.title: Voho API
info.description: Speech, agents and understanding over one HTTP API. Every endpoint takes a bearer token issued from the Voho console and draws down the same credit balance.

bearerAuth.description: API token from the Voho console. Begins with `voho_sk_live_`.

post.description: Returns finished audio as raw bytes. Details of what was produced are in the `X-Voho-*` response headers.

format.description: Overrides the Accept header when both are present.

sample_rate.description: Defaults to the format's native rate (24000, or 8000 for mulaw).

pitch.description: Pitch adjustment. Only applies to `nabra-1`; `sada-1` ignores it.

X-Voho-Cost-Cents.description: Cost of this call in cents.

400.description: Invalid request, empty text, text too long, or unknown format.

error.message: Your credit balance is exhausted. Top up to continue.

503.description: Briefly at capacity. Retry with backoff.

error.message: The voice engine is briefly at capacity. Retry shortly.

post.description: Audio as it is produced. Send `Accept: text/event-stream` for SSE with base64 chunks and a usage event; anything else returns raw chunked audio. Requires `sada-1`.

200.description: SSE event stream, or raw chunked audio.

error.message: Your credit balance is exhausted. Top up to continue.

get.description: The voice catalog plus the models, formats, and streaming capabilities available to you. Filters combine with AND.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Matched against the start of the locale.

get.description: Everything needed to configure one voice, including a ready-to-send sample request in the right language.

post.description: Returns the text as it will actually be spoken, with numbers, currency, and abbreviations expanded. Does not synthesise audio and does not draw down credits.
Flags tokens likely to be mispronounced — Latin words inside Arabic text, unexpanded digits, asset tags, and acronyms. A lexical check, not a pronunciation model.

text.example: عطل في المكيف AC-4417 في مبنى HVAC

coverage.description: Proportion of tokens that raised no flag.

get.description: Every agent on the account the token belongs to, most recently updated first.

error.message: Your credit balance is exhausted. Top up to continue.

post.description:
What the agent says next, given what the caller just said. Text in, text and audio out, so your own telephony can drive an agent configured in the console.

Billed 2 cents a turn, plus the speech of the reply at the agent's model rate.

text.description: What the caller said. Truncated at 4,000 characters.
text.example: وين طلبي؟ رقمه سبعة تسعة واحد اثنين

history.description: The conversation so far. Only the last 20 turns are used.

variables.description: Values for this call. They override the agent's stored defaults, which is the point of them — one agent, a value per call.

audio.description: Set to `false` to get text only and skip the synthesis charge.

greeting.description: The agent's greeting with variables filled in, for the start of a call.

audio.description: The spoken reply, base64 encoded. Null when `audio` was false.

cost_cents.description: What this call cost, in cents. Also returned as the `X-Voho-Cost-Cents` header.

post.description:
Reads an invoice, contract, ID or delivery note — including bad scans and mixed Arabic and English handwriting — and returns the fields the next system needs. Values come back exactly as they appear, never translated or reformatted.

Billed 4 cents a document. Files up to 8 MB.

requestBody.description: Send `multipart/form-data` with the file attached, or JSON with the file base64 encoded.

filename.description: Recorded on the run, for your own attribution.

label.description: Always English, so it can be mapped to a system, even when the value is Arabic.

confidence.description: `low` means it was inferred from a poor scan or from context — check those before they reach a ledger.

warnings.description: Anything that would make a person distrust the result: a cut-off page, a handwritten correction, two conflicting totals.

cost_cents.description: What this call cost, in cents. Also returned as the `X-Voho-Cost-Cents` header.

post.summary: Ask a question about a document
post.description:
Answers a question against one document and quotes the lines the answer rests on. When the document does not contain the answer it says so rather than filling the gap with general knowledge.

Billed 4 cents a question. Files up to 8 MB.

requestBody.description: Send `multipart/form-data` with the file attached, or JSON with the file base64 encoded.

question.example: What is the torque spec for the pump on line three, and which revision is this?

filename.description: Recorded on the run, for your own attribution.

question.example: What is the torque spec for the pump on line three, and which revision is this?

quotes.description: Verbatim lines from the document, in its own language.

answered.description: False when the document does not contain the answer. `answer` then says what is missing.

cost_cents.description: What this call cost, in cents. Also returned as the `X-Voho-Cost-Cents` header.

post.summary: Check what would leave your estate
post.description:
The boundary check: what a Saudi compliance officer would object to seeing sent outside the organisation, and the text with it stripped.

Billed 4 cents a check. Text is truncated at 6,000 characters.

text.example: العميل أحمد الشمري، هوية 1023456789، اتصل بخصوص بطاقته المنتهية 4539 8821 0034 7712.

redacted.description: The text with redactions applied inline, the rest of the wording untouched.

verdict.description: One plain sentence a non-technical manager can act on.

cost_cents.description: What this call cost, in cents. Also returned as the `X-Voho-Cost-Cents` header.

post.summary: Turn a reported fault into a work order
post.description:
Takes a fault described the way a tenant describes it and returns the fields a CAFM system such as Archibus or SAP PM requires.

Billed 4 cents a ticket. Text is truncated at 4,000 characters.

text.example: There's a smell of burning on the fourth floor, near the east stairwell.

sla_hours.description: Matches the priority: 1 for emergency, 8 for urgent, 72 for routine.

missing.description: What the caller did not say that the system will want.

cost_cents.description: What this call cost, in cents. Also returned as the `X-Voho-Cost-Cents` header.
